title: Choose Beacon's ambient world
question: Pinned by you: the club's layout and calm, light blue and white, no metal pipes. The roll picked the ambient layer: pool-floor light. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll.

options.label: Still Water Light
options.lineage: California backyard pool floors at mid-morning; Hockney's pool light
options.thesis: Slow refracted light drifting across a pale blue floor: calm, clear, never still enough to feel cold.
options.viewport: Centred Manrope hero over a full-bleed slow caustic layer; the Navigator's first question sits in the hero as a working input, not a link.
options.risk: Can read spa or resort if the caustics are too bright or too fast; kept faint and slow.

raised.raise: Light is the only tonal device: the caustic brightness carries depth, no gradients or drop shadows elsewhere.
One accent only, deep pool blue, meaning action or the current milestone, nothing else.
One reading axis: Before, During, After advance as a single sequence across the site.
One label grid rules every checklist and document row: item, status, owner, date.

options.label: Lighthouse Lens
options.lineage: Fresnel lighthouse lenses on the California coast
options.thesis: A soft beam sweeps through pale haze: the literal Beacon, a guiding light.
options.viewport: Hero headline under a slow beam that crosses the screen every 12 seconds.
options.risk: The obvious reading of the name; most runs for a product called Beacon land here.

options.label: Rain-Night Cityscape
options.thesis: A city nocturne of signals and reflections.
options.case: Dark and nocturnal; breaks your light blue and white brief and the calm families need.
options.risk: Moody where Beacon must feel safe.
options.kept: State comparison: milestone states read as distinct, legible bands.

options.label: ASCII Live Scene
options.thesis: Glyph density stands in for light.
options.case: Technical novelty; families in distress don't identify with it.
options.kept: Luminance as the only tonal device.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: Every count arrives as glowing plasma.
options.case: Instrument costume; nothing to count for a family.
options.kept: A single accent with one meaning.

options.label: Agit-Train
options.thesis: Content advances car by car along one diagonal.
options.case: Aggressive; wrong for a neutral mediator.

options.label: Sneaker Box Wall
options.kept: One label grid for every row.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A legal-services site: stock photo of a family, blue header, three feature cards.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero with photo right, headline left, three cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every family law firm site.
